text:
mikaela: Heads-up — Brookline partner invoice INV-4520 shows duplicate peering egress lines for 03/14-03/20. Looks like a double-charge; partner is asking for a correction. Estimated overcharge shows $4,800 net after promo. Can we do a manual credit + partner note?

todd_s: Can you paste the invoice snippet and the exact amount you want credited?

mikaela: Sure — snippet below (redacted customer id):

```
Invoice INV-4520
Date: 2023-03-25
Line 11: peering-egress-us-east 100 TB @ $0.05 = $5,000
Line 12: peering-egress-us-east (duplicate) 100 TB @ $0.05 = $5,000
Subtotal raw: $10,000
Expected peering charge: $5,000
Overcharge: $5,000
Partner promo applied: -$200
Net requested credit: $4,800
```

samir_devops: Looks like the peering ingestion job retried and produced duplicate events around 03/20 03:18 UTC. I can pull the raw pipeline trace and confirm.

finance-bot: Automated analysis: potential duplicate invoice lines detected (confidence 87%). Trace id: rtr-9a2f. Flagged for manual review.

mikaela: Request: manual credit of $4,800 and a credit memo/partner-facing note. Also want an ops ticket so we don't recur.

todd_s: Approve manual credit of $4,800. Please create credit memo (suggested id CM-230320-BKL) and send partner note. @karen_sales to vet wording. :thumbsup:

karen_sales: I will draft the partner message — keep it apologetic, state the credit amount, and explain we're fixing the ingestion path. Will share copy for sign-off before send.

samir_devops: Confirmed duplicate ingestion in logs. Created bug PR #394 to guard the retry path; pushed monitoring alert for duplicate invoice lines. Root cause: missing idempotency key in the peering consumer.

mikaela: Thanks — I'm adding this to billing queue today. ACTIONS: finance to issue credit memo and post credit; sales to approve partner note; eng to patch and add monitoring.

finance-bot: Credit memo CM-230320-BKL created (status: pending). Ticket FIN-2023-887 opened for the manual adjustment workflow.

todd_s: Approved. Send once memo posted and then close FIN ticket. :white_check_mark:

mikaela: Will follow up with confirmation and attach reconciliation CSV to the ticket when posted.

karen_sales: Draft ready — will ping for sign-off in the ticket thread.

samir_devops: Will monitor tomorrow's run to confirm no repeats.

mikaela: Closing loop here — thanks everyone.
